title: Reading the image version variable
description: You can inspect the shell command used to display the course image version.

steps.description: You pass $CS374_IMAGE_VERSION to echo. The dollar sign asks the shell to expand the variable's value.
CS374_IMAGE_VERSION names the value this check wants to display. The command reads that variable rather than assigning it.

steps.question: What visible version does the supplied recording show?
steps.answer: It shows a blank line with no visible version value.

steps.description: You can compare the blank recorded output with the intended version check. The recording supplies no image version to report.
